verdict: No paid campaigns are running; organic reach is declining this period.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, paid advertising was inactive across all channels, so your Google Business Profile was the only source of inbound activity — generating 37 actions from 341 impressions. In the most recent 7 days, those GBP actions fell 77% compared to the prior 7 days, and website sessions and search clicks declined in parallel, pointing to a broad softening in local visibility rather than an isolated issue. With paid channels off, there is no volume buffer to offset organic dips when they occur. Reactivating paid campaigns is the priority step to restore a reliable lead flow, and GBP profile review is underway to address the low call conversion rate that pre-dates this drop.
